dialogues.speaker: Note Inside a Treasure Chest (I)
dialogues.text: Congratulations on finding the first treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Note Inside a Treasure Chest (I)
dialogues.text: Now, time to head over to the bell tower in the <color=#00E2FFFF>southwest of the city</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Note Inside a Treasure Chest (I)
dialogues.text: The treasure's waiting for you there!
